title: [main] bug 643971 - Enhance vendor and customer checks in advance letters and update blocked status validation
summary: Advance letter creation now validates blocked customer and vendor status before proceeding, and customer blocked status check is narrowed to exclude Ship-only blocks which are irrelevant for invoicing.
key_points: Upfront blocked-customer/vendor validation added in Create Sales and Purchase Advance Letter reports
Blocked status check narrowed from all non-blank states to only All and Invoice blocks
Customers blocked for shipping only can now have advance letters created
Blocked status caught earlier in the workflow
Tests updated to validate new blocking behavior
